3.finding: After applying the CP119 distinction, all three programmes meaningfully respond to the target rather than merely forming coherent curricula. The closest route contains five philosophy courses plus political philosophy, law-and-philosophy and applied AI ethics; the technology and environmental routes retain a substantial philosophy/ethics spine while reorganising around two exact-target directions. All are explicitly presented as related UCR programmes, not replacements for a full philosophy degree.
preserved: All three concepts, sequential candidate ownership, labels, maximum-reached stopping state and the strong specialist-depth limitation note.

sourceYearFinding.governingRoute: 2026–2027 full-time Bachelor Filosofie, 22 components and 180 EC under OER Appendix 2B
sourceYearFinding.currentVisiblePublicPage: A broader and partly different elective menu
sourceYearFinding.outcome: Kept strictly separate. The formal OER governs this cohort; public-page-only subjects were not merged into the current curriculum, and RASL was excluded as a separate dual study.

independentFinalReview.externalRecheck: The fixed first two years and conditioned third year sum to 180 EC: a 15-EC non-philosophy minor, two neutral 7.5-EC Advanced Academic Skills choices, Filosofie in de Praktijk, one neutral philosophy elective and a 15-EC thesis. BA2/BA3 normally require a positive binding study advice and the thesis requires 90 EC within the programme. All 44 linked interests were reread; 40 remain current evidence and four public-page-only topics remain provenance only.
independentFinalReview.courseRecheck: Reopened the actual enriched profiles for all 47 distinct selected UCR courses across 72 placements. Every placement passed offering and prerequisite rules. Each programme contains 24 courses, 180 EC, seven advanced courses and first-year PPD. The Logic & Discrete Mathematics rationale was narrowed to the workbook-supported logic, patterns, discrete structures and computing applications.
independentFinalReview.programmeChallenge: Coherence alone would not establish comparability. The closest programme contains about 60 EC of direct philosophy and related ethics; the technology programme about 52.5 EC; and the environmental programme about 45 EC. Each therefore responds to defining philosophical substance, but none reproduces Erasmus's specialist sequence in epistemology, philosophy of science, continental metaphysics, philosophy of language, single-philosopher study or a philosophy thesis. All three remain expressly qualified related UCR programmes, not equivalents.
independentFinalReview.presentationRecheck: Actual Shiny on the implementation commit displayed all three alternatives and all 22 target components, opened all 47 distinct selected-course modals at both 1440×1000 and 390×844, preserved modal content, stayed within viewport geometry, exposed the exact source link, returned to search and produced no page errors. Six screenshots were visually inspected: desktop and mobile summary, curriculum and representative GOSPHIL214 modal. No clipping, overlap, hidden alternative or misleading presentation was found.
independentFinalReview.outcome: passed; approved qualified positive comparison with three UCR programmes
